suite: V-FAULT-01 / V-AUTH-01 — Fault injection: AuthorityTx all-or-none, commit/publication boundary, DB busy, outbox recovery

sections.name: All-or-none atomicity — fault injection at every AuthorityTx step
sections.description: Drop the transaction without commit at each stage (pre-write, after start event, after completion event, after revision reserved, after outbox enqueued, after idempotency written). All six components (events_v2, audit_records, graph_revisions, derived_outbox, idempotency_results, authority_meta) must be zero / unchanged after each drop.
sections.invariant: All-or-none: any pre-commit failure results in zero committed rows across all six components.

sections.name: Commit success / publication failure — post-commit convergence
sections.description: Commit succeeds but the post-commit WakePublisher fails (Noop, dropping wake). Committed truth must be fully recoverable from revisions_since() and outbox pending(). Re-publishing the same wake multiple times must not alter committed rows.
sections.invariant: Publication failure cannot alter committed truth; revisions_since + outbox pending provides full recovery.

sections.name: DB busy state — busy_timeout pragma and concurrent write serialization
sections.description: Verify busy_timeout >= 5000ms on the authority connection. Concurrent writes from 8 threads produce exactly 8 distinct revisions without corruption or panics. A write under lock contention eventually succeeds within busy_timeout.
sections.invariant: busy_timeout >= 5000ms; concurrent writes are serialized, never corrupted or panicked.

sections.name: Outbox lease/apply failure recovery
sections.description: mark_failed with retry_at -> status=pending+attempts++; mark_failed without retry_at -> dead_letter; mark_done -> applied, not in pending(); multiple failures increment attempts correctly; past retry_at item re-appears in pending() for retry.
sections.invariant: Outbox delivery failures increment attempts, schedule retry, or dead-letter; retry-eligible items re-appear in pending(); mark_done removes from pending().

sections.name: Recovery_Mode entry: isolated derived failures
sections.description: A failing derived-projection (FTS) does not affect pending outbox items for other targets (vectors, scene). Committed authority rows are completely unaffected by outbox delivery failures.
sections.invariant: Derived projection failures are isolated; authority committed rows are never altered by outbox delivery failures.

notes: All 21 tests pass using in-memory SQLite (Database::open_in_memory).
All-or-none atomicity proven at every AuthorityTx stage (S1): drop-without-commit at any step leaves zero committed rows in all six tables.
Post-commit convergence proven (S2): NoopWakePublisher and re-published wakes never alter committed rows; revisions_since recovers all missed revisions.
DB busy_timeout=5000ms verified by PRAGMA read-back (S3); 8-thread concurrent write test confirms serialization without corruption.
Outbox lease/apply failure recovery proven (S4): retry scheduling, dead-lettering, attempt counting, and re-eligibility all correct.
Isolated derived failures proven (S5): FTS failure does not block vectors/scene; authority truth is stable regardless of projection delivery.
Owner self-review accepted per .kiro/steering/dev-context.md (single-developer pre-production project).
